import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    payments = inputs["payments"].copy()

    def classify(row):
        amount = row["amount"]
        if pd.isna(amount):
            return "AMT_NULL"
        if amount <= 0:
            return "AMT_NONPOS"
        currency = row["currency"]
        if pd.notna(currency) and currency not in ("USD", "EUR", "GBP"):
            return "CCY_INVALID"
        if pd.isna(row["country"]):
            return "CTRY_NULL"
        return None

    reason_codes = payments.apply(classify, axis=1)

    is_rejected = reason_codes.notna()

    clean = payments.loc[~is_rejected].copy()
    clean["amount"] = clean["amount"].round(2)

    rejects = payments.loc[is_rejected].copy()
    rejects["reason_code"] = reason_codes.loc[is_rejected]

    clean = clean.reset_index(drop=True)
    rejects = rejects.reset_index(drop=True)

    return {
        "payments_clean": clean,
        "payments_rejects": rejects,
    }
